mapper.sql: select a.id as acceptance_id, a.code as acceptance_code, a.accept_date, a.total_amount as acceptance_total_amount, do.code as delivery_code, do.delivery_date, a.customer_id, coalesce(customer.alias, customer.name) as customer_name, a.delivery_point_id, cd.name as delivery_point_name, ai.product_name, ai.product_spec, ai.product_unit, ai.actual_quantity, ai.loss_quantity, ai.unit_price, ai.actual_amount, ai.sort from acceptance a inner join acceptance_item ai on ai.acceptance_id = a.id inner join t_delivery_order do on do.id = a.delivery_order_id left join t_customer customer on customer.id = a.customer_id left join t_customer_dept cd on cd.id = a.delivery_point_id
